data.narrative:
Epoch Biodesign is a Series A biotech company founded by Jacob Nathan that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent stages, yielding an implied valuation of $80M. Peer-median analysis could not be conducted—while 7 same-sector comparables exist in Biotech & Health, none satisfied narrow filters for same-stage or adjacent-stage matching with sufficient sample size (minimum 3 required). Public-comp anchoring using sector P/S multiples proved inapplicable because Epoch's revenue remains undisclosed, typical for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, centered on $80M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method and highlights material uncertainty: absence of peer revenue multiples, lack of disclosed financial metrics, and limited ability to benchmark against privately-held comparables. Any Series A valuation remains highly sensitive to recent funding terms, burn profile, and pipeline advancement—none of which are available here.
